intro: Tah Winterhoof of Thunder Bluff needs a traveler to journey into the Stonetalon Mountains to replenish his supply of red paint pigment. The requested material comes from mirkweed, a unique aquatic plant growing in Mirkfallon Lake whose dried pods yield a vibrant crimson dye.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.

In the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
